scope: All 198 prior controls plus all 36 now-known background challenges are development replay; no held-out or independent-object claim. Frozen v4 baseline and v5 persistent-valley gate compared without case-specific retuning.

interpretation_limits.development: The new 36 conditions informed this gate and are no longer unseen. Preserve every old condition including the branch-negative task definition.
interpretation_limits.unidentifiable: Same-input semantic collisions are not included in pass/fail denominators; v5 cannot infer missing physical identity.
interpretation_limits.gap: Original gap proximity is reported without relaxed guards or success claims.
interpretation_limits.resolution: A one-voxel valley observed in 4/6 axial slices is supporting evidence, not proof that unresolved close rods are one member. Whole-component fallback can still be wrong.

freeze_note: Only a fixed persistent transverse density-valley test is added to old split proposals. All other v4 policies remain frozen. Copy exactly all old anonymous point files; labels remain in eval_gt. No changes after prepared state.
